cases.question: How many PTO days do new employees get, and can unused days roll over?

gold_chunk: carry over up to 5 unused PTO days

answer.content:
New full-time employees receive **18 days of PTO per calendar year**, accruing at **1.5 days per month** starting on the first day of employment; part-time employees accrue PTO in proportion to their scheduled hours. [S1]

Up to **5 unused PTO days** may roll over into the next calendar year and must be used by **March 31**; any other unused days are forfeited on **December 31** and are not paid out, except where local law requires a payout. [S1]

LRK-4471 was the August platform outage: on August 12, 2026, a failed database migration caused a 9-hour outage of Larkspur’s forecasting platform, affecting 41 customers. [S1]

- **Root cause:** A schema change was applied without a tested rollback plan. [S1]
- **Cost:** Service credits, overtime and remediation work totaled $120k. [S1]
- **Corrective actions:** Every migration now requires a tested rollback plan, schema changes roll out to 5% of customers first, and a public status page launched on September 1. [S1]
- **Status:** The October 2, 2026 board update said remediation was complete and follow-up actions were on track; it described the outage as the most serious incident that year. [S5]
- **Availability impact:** Quarterly platform availability was 99.62%, below the internal target of 99.9% because of the outage. [S1]

cases.question: What is the remote work stipend? Has it changed?

gold_chunk: remote work stipend of $500 per year

answer.content:
The remote work stipend is currently **$750 per year**, increased from **$500 per year**, effective **October 1, 2026**, following board approval. [S2]

- The handbook dated 2026-01-15 still lists $500 per year, but the more recent board update dated 2026-10-02 records the increase and says People Operations will update the handbook in its next edition; the $750 rate is therefore current as of 2026-10-21. [S1][S2]
- The stipend helps cover internet, furniture and other home-office costs; the handbook says it is paid in the January payroll and prorated for employees who join during the year. [S1]
- The coworking allowance is separate from the remote work stipend. [S1]

cases.question: Which vendor is cheaper over three years, and which has the stronger SLA?

answer.content:
**BrightPath is cheaper over three years at the quoted subscription rates: $600,000 versus CoreLink’s $665,000, a $65,000 difference; however, CoreLink’s subscription pricing is locked only for the first 24 months, so its actual three-year total is not guaranteed.** [S1][S2] **CoreLink has the stronger SLA**, with higher uptime, larger service credits per smaller shortfall, and 24/7 support. [S1][S2][S3]

- **BrightPath cost:** $420,000 + 3 × $60,000 = **$600,000**, excluding applicable taxes. [S1]
- **CoreLink cost:** $380,000 + 3 × $95,000 = **$665,000**, assuming the quoted annual subscription remains unchanged in year 3; $665,000 − $600,000 = **$65,000**. [S1][S2]
- **CoreLink SLA:** 99.9% monthly uptime; credits of 10% of the monthly subscription fee for each 0.1% below target, capped at 50%; 24/7 support. [S2]
- **BrightPath SLA:** 99.5% monthly uptime; credits of 5% of that month’s subscription fee for each 0.5% below target; business-hours support (8:00 to 18:00 Mountain Time), with a 4-hour response target for priority 1 issues. [S1][S3]

answer.content:
After three years of continuous service, full-time employees receive **20 PTO days per year**: 18 base days + 2 additional days = 20 days; the increase applies from the first full month after the employee's third work anniversary. [S1]

**Yes, unused days can roll over**, subject to these rules: [S1]
- Up to 5 unused PTO days may carry over into the next calendar year and must be used by March 31. [S1]
- Any other unused days are forfeited on December 31 and are not paid out, except where local law requires a payout. [S1]
